basic_profile.bio: Avid storyteller and gaming enthusiast based in the Midwest. I enjoy crafting narratives, whether they are creepy tales or heartwarming anecdotes. I have a penchant for strategy games and often lose myself in them during late-night sessions. By day, I work as a high school English teacher, trying to inspire the next generation of writers. I'm in a long-term relationship and often share my love for gaming with my partner. You can find me online in the evenings, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge spans from storytelling, which I've honed through years of teaching and writing, to gaming strategy, particularly in simulation games like Plague Inc. My understanding of digital devices and platforms is largely self-taught, driven by my interest in tech and gaming.
